modules.title: 税费规则变化后，哪些旧流程要重新跑

items.title: 从改动的影响面找旧用例
items.text: 税费参与订单总价，就应重跑优惠券、支付金额和确认页，而不只看新税率。范围来自数据和流程的关联，不是机械地把所有测试都再跑一次。

items.title: 用原有期望抓住意外变化
items.text: 原来能完成的下单、原来正确的金额或原来清楚的错误提示，如果在这次修改后变了，就是需要处理的回归。记录修改前后结果能帮助定位。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 回归测试不是测试新增功能本身，也不等于冒烟测试。冒烟测试快速判断版本是否明显可用；回归测试专门检查修改是否伤到了原先正常的相关能力。

lessonPractice.title: 团队只改了优惠券计算，却发现总价会影响支付和订单确认。哪组最该加入回归测试？

options.label: 原有优惠券、支付金额和订单确认用例
options.feedback: 对。这些旧流程都依赖总价，最可能被这次变化误伤。

options.label: 只检查新优惠券是否能显示
options.feedback: 新规则显示不代表旧的支付和确认结果仍正确。

options.label: 只检查个人头像上传
options.feedback: 除非有明确共享依赖，否则它不在这次改动的主要风险面。

en.title: The team changed only coupon calculation, but the total also affects payment and order confirmation. Which set belongs in regression?

options.label: Existing coupon, payment-total, and order-confirmation cases
options.feedback: Correct. These older paths depend on the total and are most likely to be harmed by the change.

options.label: Only check that the new coupon displays
options.feedback: Displaying the new rule does not prove old payment and confirmation results remain correct.

options.label: Only check profile-avatar upload
options.feedback: Without a known shared dependency, it is not in this change's main risk area.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 税费和优惠券规则改完后，请按影响面跑回归：原有优惠券、支付金额和订单确认都要重测。不要只报新规则通过；把每条旧路径的实际结果列出来。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: After changing tax and coupon rules, run regression by impact: retest existing coupons, payment totals, and order confirmation. Do not only report the new rule passing; list the actual result for each older path.

learning.assumes: You know one code change can affect nearby functions that seem unrelated.
learning.outcome: You can select previously working paths that need rechecking based on change risk.

modules.title: Which old flows rerun after a tax rule changes

items.title: Find old cases from the impact surface
items.text: Because tax participates in order total, rerun coupons, payment amount, and confirmation—not merely the new rate. Scope comes from data and flow connections, not mechanically rerunning everything.

items.title: Use prior expectations to catch surprises
items.text: A checkout that used to complete, an amount that used to be correct, or an old clear error that changes after this edit is a regression worth addressing. Compare results before and after.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: Regression is not testing the new feature itself, nor is it smoke testing. Smoke quickly asks whether a version is plainly usable; regression asks whether a change harmed related, previously working capabilities.

distinctions.label: Smoke test
distinctions.text: A {c:regression-test} reruns existing behavior according to change risk. A {c:smoke-test} first checks only basic abilities such as home, login, and a core API.
